# Claim ledger

This ledger maps the report’s load-bearing claims to exact sources and records scope, calculations, contrary evidence, and revision triggers.

| ID | Claim | Status | Direct support | Calculation / extraction | Scope and limitations | Revision trigger |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C01 | Opus 4.8 async subagents underperformed its 10M solo BrowseComp baseline. | Vendor-reported observation | [O48-SC p. 210, Fig. 8.11.1.A](sources/Claude_Opus_4.8_System_Card.pdf#page=210) | 83.0 − 84.3 = −1.3 pp from rounded labels | BrowseComp; Opus 4.8 card harness only | Re-run with same harness and current snapshots |
| C02 | Fable/Mythos 5 async subagents improved over its 10M solo baseline. | Vendor-reported observation | [F5-SC p. 272, Fig. 8.15.1.A](sources/Claude_Fable_5_and_Mythos_5_System_Card.pdf#page=272) | 93.3 − 88.0 = +5.3 pp | Separate card and configuration | Controlled same-worker comparison |
| C03 | Opus 5 async subagents improved over its 10M solo baseline. | Vendor-reported observation | [O5-SC pp. 163–164](sources/Claude_Opus_5_System_Card.pdf#page=163) | Rounded labels: 93.4 − 90.5 = +2.9 pp; prose says +2.8 pp | Pre-release model and unreleased effort; no safeguard classifiers | Released-config replication |
| C04 | Opus 5 and Fable async BrowseComp endpoints are approximately tied. | Cross-source synthesis | C02, C03 | 93.4 versus 93.3 | Not a one-decimal superiority test; separate cards | One controlled head-to-head |
